review: capture_io and runtime batch 01-04 control readers
scope_state: all five paths are currently untracked; no tracked diff is available as a baseline

findings.issue: The SM121 kernel matrix accepts JSON booleans false for load_exit_code and first_inference_exit_code because bool is equal to integer zero in Python. Unlike neighboring checks, these fields have no exact-int validation.
findings.impact: A capture can assert a successful kernel load and first inference with boolean values rather than recorded process return codes, then satisfy this check.

minimal_reproduction.command:
python - <<'PY'
from tools.runtime_batch02_controls import assess
card='DELTA-FORUM-NEMOTRON-SM121-PREBUILT-KERNEL-01'
D='sha256:'+'a'*64
x={'schema':'bb.runtime.raw.v1','card_id':card,'capture_id':'x','captured_at':'2026-10-04T00:00:00Z','subject':{'oem':'x','host_id':'h','model':'m','software_versions':{'sglang':'1','sgl_kernel':'2','cuda':'3','driver':'4'},'image_digest':D,'checkpoint_digest':D,'sm_arch':'sm_121'},'request_bounds':{'request_id':'r','model':'m','checkpoint_digest':D,'max_tokens':10,'max_context_tokens':100,'deadline_seconds':10,'started_at':'2026-10-04T00:00:00Z','finished_at':'2026-10-04T00:00:01Z'},'required_operations':['gemm'],'architecture_kernel_matrix':[{'sm_arch':'sm_121','operation':'gemm','kernel_name':'k','load_exit_code':False,'first_inference_exit_code':False,'raw_output':'ok'}],'reference_output':{'request_id':'r','observed':'ok','expected':'ok'},'architecture_negative':{'sm_arch':'sm_90','required_op':'gemm','argv_sha256':'abc','exit_code':1,'stderr_raw':'unsupported'}}

findings.suggested_fix: Require type(value) is int for both positive exit-code fields before comparing them to zero.
findings.additional_affected_predicate: tools/runtime_batch02_controls.py:_cold_compile also compares compile_exit_code == 0 at line 459 without an exact-int guard; the same Python bool/int equality lets false satisfy it. The executable minimal reproduction exercises the SM121 matrix branch.

capture_io_review.read_regular_bytes: Static inspection found component-wise O_NOFOLLOW traversal, fstat regular-file enforcement, nonblocking open, bounded max_bytes+1 read, and parent-traversal rejection. No concrete unsafe-read or accepted-oversize finding reproduced in this review.
capture_io_review.strict_json_loads: Rejects duplicate object keys and non-finite constants.

checks.targeted_reproduction: pass: synthetic batch-02 capture returned status=pass with both positive return-code fields set to JSON false

cnr: No positive runtime-capture.json files were present under the Nemotron, Qwen cold-compile, vLLM architecture-matrix, or Ray resource-fix card evidence directories, so no claim was tested against those real captures.
